brief:
Regional affairs researcher Muhammad Odeh Al-Aga told Shehab Wire that ongoing Israeli targeting of civilians and service workers in Gaza reflects a systematic occupation mentality designed to displace Palestinians from all spheres of life. He characterized the strikes as an assault on "the last outlet" for Gaza's residents, suggesting the operations aim to eliminate remaining spaces where ordinary life can continue.

Al-Aga said Israeli forces also pursue police personnel throughout the territory to destabilize civil order and plunge Gaza into chaos. He framed these dual tactics—attacks on civilians and service workers alongside pursuit of security forces—as part of a coherent strategy rooted in expulsion and displacement rather than isolated military operations.
